name: wybe-connect
description: Feeds your Wybe AI colleague from Codex. Hooks send redacted session deltas per the OAuth scopes you granted (sessions:light = your own prompts and metadata; sessions:full = also assistant output and tool I/O); the connect skill pairs this machine once. Sends only; the one thing that comes back is a task you gave your colleague for an open session, and one that needs your yes is shown to you first.
